title: Quotient and remainder of the division loop
statement: Let $z$ be a bit string whose second projection has positive value. After the division loop on $z$, the value of the third nested second projection is the quotient of the value of the first projection by the value of the second projection, and the value of the first projection of the second nested second projection is the corresponding remainder.
hypotheses_covered: The value of its second projection is positive
